questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code maps failures to HTTP status codes and error responses? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client PUTs a new version of a file without sending an If-Match header. What does it receive?

Two devices both hold version 4 and upload edits with If-Match "4". The second request is handled after the store has moved to version 5 and throws StaleVersionException. What does the second device see?
choices: 412 with currentVersion 5 in the error details so it can re-sync
200 because the store overwrote the file
500, since the exception is not mapped

questions.prompt: A file is 1000 bytes long and the client sends Range: bytes=1000-. What happens?
choices: 206 with an empty body and Content-Range bytes 1000-999/1000
